summary: Not classifieds: a Friday entertainment page. A narrow 'In Indianapolis Today' listing column and a mosaic of cinema display ads (The Hellstrom Chronicle, Billy Jack, Carnal Knowledge, Doc) plus a state-fair ad.

units.notes: Theatre name in bold caps, film in quotes.

units.example: Held Over 2nd Big Week! / THE HELLSTROM CHRONICLE
units.notes: Black reverse panels, photo halftones, theatre logo bars and 'Bargain matinee' tags.

notes: Same adjacent section type as cl-028 (entertainment directory). Useful for 1970s display lettering (psychedelic NOW at the FAIR) more than for classifieds.
